description: This file defines the 'FilterFunction' interface, which specifies the contract for filtering functions used in filtering mechanisms within the project.

classes.name: FilterFunction
classes.description: An interface representing a filter function used for determining whether an element should be kept or dropped based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Determines whether an element should be filtered (dropped) or kept based on provided parameters.
